title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more

translated_title: 基于小型语言模型的模板空缺重构Shell输出模拟方法
translated_abstract: 小型语言模型为无需实际执行所提交命令的Shell模拟提供了紧凑的基础，但完整输出解码要求模型在预测跨执行而变化的内容的同时，还需预测反复出现的工具输出结构。我们提出了模板空缺重构（TGR）方法，该方法提供可复用的输出字面量，其中穿插着哨兵标记，以便与自回归生成的空缺内容交错拼接。模板选择器负责选择需要重构的模板，而空模板则保留为完整输出解码方式。我们从跨异构执行环境收集的1870万个输出中构建了一个模板库，并在一个未参与模板库构建的目标环境上，基于多种小型语言模型检查点初始化，训练了一个模板选择器和五个重构模型。评估结果表明，当最优模板覆盖更多内容时，TGR在输出编辑相似度（O-ES）指标上优于完整输出解码（FOD）……
tldr: 该论文提出模板空缺重构（TGR）方法，通过从1870万个真实输出构建的模板库中提供可复用的输出字面量并与自回归生成的空缺内容交错，使小型语言模型在Shell输出模拟中显著优于完整输出解码。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Template Gap Reconstruction (TGR), which leverages a template bank built from 18.7 million real outputs to supply reusable output literals interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps, enabling small language models to outperform full-output decoding in shell output simulation.
